description: This source file defines a React functional component named FormWizard that implements a multi-step form wizard interface with validation, editable review sections, progress indication, and submission gating, primarily used for collecting user account, profile, preferences, and consent data.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the current or specified step in the form process, updating the errors state with validation messages, and returning a boolean indicating whether the validation passed.

methods.name: step1Valid
methods.description: A memoized boolean indicating the validity of the first step based on username, password, and confirmation.

methods.name: step2Valid
methods.description: A memoized boolean indicating the validity of the second step based on first name, last name, and email.

methods.name: step3Valid
methods.description: A memoized boolean indicating the validity of the third step based on topic and delivery frequency.

methods.name: percentComplete
methods.description: A memoized calculation of overall progress percentage based on completed steps.

methods.name: goToStep
methods.description: Navigates to a target step, validating prior steps if moving forward, and handling user focus safeguards.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step if the current step's validation passes.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates form data state for a given field in response to user input, with debounced validation triggers.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a specific section from the review view.

methods.name: saveFromEdit
methods.description: Validates and saves changes after editing a section, then returns to review.

methods.name: canProceed()
methods.description: Determines if the user can proceed to the next step based on current step validity.
